extension.description: Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: v1.6.0: Launching Setup with no device env now opens the Guided wizard — choose Foundation / IPTV / Add-ons, or "Install everything with defaults" — so a manual launch installs nothing until chosen; the unattended Express one-tap still runs whenever a device env is present. (v1.5.0: Modular Setup — Express one-tap unchanged; three standalone layers (run_foundation, run_iptv, run_addons), each leaving a complete working box; Guided wizard via SETUP_MODE=guided with per-gate restarts and the Model A lifecycle (Setup persists across gates, env consumed at Finish, then self-uninstalls); shared-library SETUP_API compatibility guard. (v1.4.0: Per-device config from one .env — the provisioner derives a per-device tony7bones.env and the Setup reads it to set weather (up to 5 locations + optional Weatherbit/OpenWeatherMap keys), IPTV (custom groups + m3u/EPG), and RSS feeds, then removes it; built-in defaults when absent. (v1.3.3: Live TV now loads only the custom channel groups — the Setup enforces pvr.iptvsimple's "Only load TV channels in groups" (tvChannelGroupsOnly) alongside the custom-groups mode + file. (v1.3.2: Reliable skin activation — Setup now ACCEPTS Kodi's "Keep this skin?" confirmation when it switches to Estuary MOD V2, so the choice persists across the end-of-setup restart instead of reverting to stock Estuary. (v1.3.1: Adds three File-Manager sources — "special://home" (special://home), "special://kodi" (/storage/emulated/0/kodi/), and ".tony.7.bones" (https://tony7bones.github.io/). New sources de-dupe by name and path; and ANY existing source pointing at the repo URL — with or without a trailing slash, under any label — is renamed to ".tony.7.bones". (v1.3.0: one-shot also installs + activates the Estuary MOD V2 skin and the MOD V2+ patch auto-applies via its service.)
